title: Barron Park Donkeys
specs: Donkey Perry was the model for the Donkey character in the Shrek movies
Donkeys live in a private pasture along the bike path near Bol Park
Volunteers must reside in Palo Alto or Palo Alto Unified School District
Volunteers 16-17 may volunteer independently with parental waiver
Volunteers under 16 considered individually and require adult supervision
gap: No pricing or fees stated for visiting or volunteering
blurb: Guests can visit the donkeys at their private pasture gate any time, meet and pet them during Sunday walks in Bol Park from 10:00 to 11:00, or see them fed at the gate on Sundays at 5:00pm (4pm in winter). The donkeys live on a special diet and are cared for by volunteers. The project is volunteer-run and donation-supported, preserving a local tradition since the 1950s.
extraNote: Never bring food for the donkeys; they are fed a special diet to maintain health · Feeding and walking volunteers must coordinate substitutes if unable to attend scheduled times · Private pasture gate near Bol Park, Palo Alto
